## Customization review (required for user-visible changes)

- [ ] User-visible behavior is configurable in Settings or has an appropriate control (enable/disable, selection, or adjustable value).
- [ ] The setting is saved and survives app restarts.
- [ ] Turning the feature off actually disables its behavior and avoids unnecessary background work/resources.
- [ ] If the behavior is intentionally not configurable, I explained the technical reason below.
- [ ] This is an internal performance/stability/security optimization that does not need a user-facing toggle.
